text: pe. yā saññā . ye saṅkhārā . yaṃ viññāṇaṃ jātaṃ pātubhūtaṃ tassa uppādo paññāyati vayo paññāyati ṭhitassa aññathattaṃ paññāyati . imesaṃ kho ānanda dhammānaṃ uppādo paññāyati vayo paññāyati ṭhitānaṃ aññathattaṃ paññāyatīti . evaṃ puṭṭho tvaṃ ānanda evaṃ byākareyyāsīti . [83] sāvatthiyaṃ . tatra kho . dhammānudhammapaṭipannassa bhikkhave bhikkhuno ayamanudhammo hoti yaṃ rūpe nibbidābahulo 1 vihareyya vedanāya nibbidābahulo vihareyya saññāya nibbidābahulo
